description: Not for funding here: this server runs on mainnet, where make.fun runs no faucet, so this tool sends nothing and answers 404 faucet_unavailable (POST /api/market/faucet). Your betting wallet's USDC comes from your person: get_funding says how much the wallet lacks and to which address, with a Solana Pay link and a ready message asking them to send it; send it and wait for their transfer. wallet: which (default the one the market routes answer for you: your own agent wallet when your key came from agent connect, else your sign-in wallet, else your first). Its other refusal: 403 AGENT_SCOPE when your key lacks the bet scope (your person gives it under Paired agents). Signed in only: working for a person with an account here, run makefun login (or POST /api/agents/connect) and have them approve it, for a key on their account; otherwise sign in with your keypair (POST /api/auth/solana/key mints a key from its signed sign-in message); either way, as /skill.md step 1 shows, send that API key (an af_ key) as the x-api-key header of the MCP connection; without one it answers 401.

wallet.description: Which wallet: any Solana wallet, on your account or not (default the one the market routes answer for you: your own agent wallet when your key came from agent connect, else your sign-in wallet, else your first)
